responseMessage:
Hey. I’m here. Breathe with me for a second.

You’re not back at zero. One night doesn’t erase all the work you’ve done. I know you’ve been fighting hard. Slip-ups happen. You’re still you.

Let’s keep it simple right now. Drink some water. Eat a little something if you can. Open a window. Small things help.

If there’s anything left around, toss it. Delete the contact. You know the drill. No shame, just clean the space.

You don’t have to figure out the whole week today. Just today. Stay close to the safe stuff. Work, a shower, a nap, whatever keeps you steady.

I’m proud of you for telling me. That’s courage. Remember the streak you had—six months wasn’t an accident. That’s you. That’s still in you.

If it helps, do the basics: rinse your face, change your shirt, put on comfy socks. Then maybe a quick walk or sit by the window. Ground yourself.

You’re not alone in this. I’m staying with you. We can reset together. Tonight can be a clean one. You’ve done that before. You can do it again.
